title: Fastest-Species Selection in Critical Multispecies Competition-Diffusion Systems via an Entropy Approach
summary: We study an $N$-species competition--diffusion system with a common competition term, for which the associated ODE system admits infinitely many equilibria. For $N=2$, Alfaro and Xiao \cite{AlfaroXiao2023} studied the long-time behavior of solutions with compactly supported initial data by constructing precise super- and sub-solutions. For $N \geq 3$, the absence of a comparison principle for the entire system presents a major difficulty.
